SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(b.spent) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019')
  - 
  (SELECT SUM(b.spent) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020')
  AS difference
